newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH MINFIN TO AUCTION THREE-YEAR BONDS MONTHLY.
newsitem.headline: POLISH MINFIN TO AUCTION THREE-YEAR BONDS MONTHLY.

text.p: The Polish finance ministry has increased its number of three-year bond auctions to monthly from quarterly, the ministry's public debt department head said in the Saturday edition of daily Dziennik Prawa i Gospodarki.

"The finance minister has changed the principles for selling three-year bonds, separating wholesale from retail selling and introducing a monthly cycle of auctions," Piotr Dziewulski was quoted as saying.
He said small investors would buy three-year bonds on subscription, as is the case with one-year bonds.
The first monthly auction is due to take place on July 30 this year, with series I and II worth 800 million zlotys, series III and IV 900 million zlotys.

"The more frequent and cyclical organisation of auctions should improve the liquidity of three-year bonds and thus make more efficient the secondary wholesale market of that paper," Dziewuski was quoted in another daily on Saturday, Parkiet.
